Ration Card — Apply, List & e-KYC Guide

• Last updated: 2026-09-15 · 3 min read
Share:
In simple words:

Ration card ek official document hai jo eligible families ko subsidized food grains (chawal, gehu, sugar) government ke Public Distribution System (PDS) ke through provide karta hai. Yeh proof of identity aur proof of address bhi maana jaata hai.

S
Samjho Content Team ✓

Trusted and policy experts simplifying MSME, tax, and compliance for India. Verified by Chartered Accountants.

Simple explanation

Ration card ek government-issued card hai jo aapko fair price shops (ration shops) se subsidized rates par food grains kharidne ka right deta hai. National Food Security Act (NFSA) 2013 ke under, eligible households ko ₹3 per kg rice, ₹2 per kg wheat aur ₹1 per kg coarse grains milte hain.

Ration cards mainly 3 types ke hote hain: APL (Above Poverty Line) — jo general category ke liye hai, BPL (Below Poverty Line) — jo low-income families ke liye hai, aur AAY (Antyodaya Anna Yojana) — jo sabse garib families ke liye hai. Har state apna naming convention use karti hai.

Ration card ke liye apply karne ke liye aapko apne state ke Food & Civil Supplies department ki website par jaana hota hai ya nearest ration office / CSC centre jaana hota hai. Application form mein family details, income proof, address proof aur Aadhaar lagta hai.

Aaj kal almost sabhi states mein e-KYC (Aadhaar-based biometric verification) mandatory ho gaya hai ration card se grains lene ke liye. Bina e-KYC ke aapka ration card temporarily block ho sakta hai.

Why does it matter?

Ration card sirf sasta anaaj tak hi seemit nahi hai — yeh ek important identity document bhi hai jo address proof ke roop mein bank account, gas connection, aur kai government schemes mein kaam aata hai. Eligible families ke liye yeh monthly food security ka sabse bada sahara hai.

Example

In numbers

Ek BPL family jisme 4 members hain, unhe NFSA ke under monthly 5 kg per person = total 20 kg food grains milte hain subsidized rate par. Agar market mein 1 kg rice ₹40 ka hai, toh ration shop se same rice sirf ₹3 per kg = ₹60 mein milta hai. Market price ₹800 hoti 20 kg ki, ration se sirf ₹60 — yeh ₹740 ki monthly bachat hai.

Important things to know

  • Ration card state government issue karti hai — apply karna hai toh apne state ke Food Department website par jaayein.
  • NFSA ke under eligible households ko 5 kg per person per month subsidized grains milte hain.
  • APL, BPL aur AAY — teen main categories hain, har category ka subsidy amount alag hota hai.
  • Aadhaar seeding (linking) almost sabhi states mein mandatory ho chuka hai ration card ke saath.
  • e-KYC / biometric verification ration shop par anaaj lene ke liye zaroori hai.
  • Ek family ka ek hi ration card ho sakta hai — do jagah apply karna illegal hai.
  • Ration card mein family members add ya remove karwa sakte hain — state process follow karein.
  • Online application status apne state portal par track kar sakte hain.

Common mistakes

  • Galat state portal par apply karna — ration card state-level scheme hai, apne state ki Food Department website hi use karein.
  • Aadhaar linking delay karna — bina Aadhaar seeding ke ration milna band ho sakta hai.
  • Fake agents ko paise dena — ration card apply karna free ya nominal fee hai, sirf official channels use karein.
  • Income ya family size mein galat information dena — verification fail ho sakta hai aur penalty lag sakti hai.
  • e-KYC na karwana — agar aapka ration card block ho gaya hai toh pehle nearest CSC ya ration office par e-KYC karwayein.

Frequently asked questions

Ration card ke liye online apply kaise karein?

Apne state ki Food & Civil Supplies department ki official website par jaayein. 'New Ration Card Application' section mein form bharein, required documents (Aadhaar, income proof, address proof, passport photo) upload karein aur submit karein. Application number milega jisse status track kar sakte hain.

Ration card list mein apna naam kaise check karein?

Apne state Food Department website par 'Ration Card List' ya 'Beneficiary List' section mein jaayein. District, block aur village/ward select karein. Aapka naam list mein hoga agar aapki family NFSA ke under eligible hai. One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) portal par bhi check kar sakte hain.

Ration card e-KYC kaise karein?

Nearest CSC centre ya ration office par jaayein apne Aadhaar card ke saath. Biometric (fingerprint) verification hoga aur Aadhaar ration card se link ho jaayega. Kuch states mein online e-KYC ka option bhi available hai state portal par.

Ration card transfer kaise karwayein?

Agar aap ek state se doosri state mein shift hue hain, toh 'Portability' feature ke under One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) se aap kisi bhi state ke fair price shop se grains le sakte hain. Permanent transfer ke liye purane state se surrender certificate lein aur nayi state mein apply karein.

Ration card mein naam add ya delete kaise karein?

Apne state Food Department portal par 'Modification' ya 'Update' section mein jaayein. Name addition ke liye naye member ka Aadhaar aur relationship proof lagta hai. Name deletion (death, marriage, migration) ke liye relevant document upload karein. Process 15-30 din mein complete hota hai.

Ration card kaun-kaun apply kar sakta hai?

Koi bhi Indian resident family apply kar sakti hai. Eligibility criteria state-wise alag hain lekin generally income, family size aur existing assets dekhe jaate hain. APL card ke liye income limit zyada hai, BPL ke liye kam. AAY cards specifically destitute families ke liye hain.
